name: gst-invoice-check
title: GST Invoice Check
description: Compares the supplier GSTIN's state with the place of supply to pick CGST + SGST/UTGST or IGST (SEZ and exports always IGST), checks each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date, LUT exports, the CGST/SGST split and the totals, with a one-tap fix.

"use client" // Bollard UI — gst-invoice-check · MIT licence · https://bollard-ui.vercel.app/components/gst-invoice-check import * as React from "react" import { ArrowRight, CircleAlert, CircleCheck, Info, TriangleAlert } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { checkGstInvoice, type GstCharged, type GstHead, type GstInvoice, type GstIssue } from "@/components/gst-invoice-check/gst" import { GST_STATES } from "@/components/tax-id-input/tax-id" export * from "@/components/gst-invoice-check/gst" const HEADS: Record = { cgst: "CGST", sgst: "SGST", utgst: "UTGST", igst: "IGST" } /** Every sentence the check shows. Override any of them to reword or translate. */ export const GST_INVOICE_CHECK_MESSAGES = { title: "GST check", intra: (local: string) => `Same state · CGST + ${local}`, inter: "Inter-state · IGST", sez: "SEZ supply · IGST", export: "Export · IGST", onInvoice: "On invoice", shouldBe: "Should be", total: "Total", ok: "Tax head, rates and totals check out.", gstin: (party: string) => `The ${party} GSTIN isn't valid, so the state code can't be trusted.`, noPos: "Add the place of supply. It decides between CGST + SGST and IGST.", headInter: (from: string, to: string) => `${from} to ${to} is an inter-state supply. Charge IGST, not CGST + SGST.`, headIntra: (state: string) => `Supplier and place of supply are both in ${state}. Charge CGST + SGST, not IGST.`, headSez: "Supplies to an SEZ are inter-state even within one state. Charge IGST.", utHead: (wanted: string) => `This union territory charges ${wanted}, not ${wanted === "UTGST" ? "SGST" : "UTGST"}.`, split: (cgst: string, other: string) => `CGST (${cgst}) and the state share (${other}) must be equal halves.`, rate: (line: string, rate: string, retired: boolean, endedOn?: string, rare?: boolean) => !retired ? `${line}: ${rate} isn't a GST rate.` : endedOn === "2026-02-01" ? `${line}: the ${rate} slab ended on 1 Feb 2026. Tobacco and pan masala moved to 40%, bidis to 18%.` : rare && rate === "28%" ? `${line}: since 22 Sep 2025, 28% is only for tobacco and pan masala (and from 1 Feb 2026 they move to 40%). Most items moved to 18%.` : rare ? `${line}: ${rate} ended on 22 Sep 2025 for almost everything (it survives only for some older housing projects). Most items moved to 5% or 18%.` : `${line}: the ${rate} slab ended on 22 Sep 2025. Most items moved to 5% or 18%.`, lut: "Under an LUT this supply is zero-rated: charge no GST, and note \"supply meant for export under LUT without payment of IGST\" on the invoice.", amount: (head: string, charged: string, expected: string) => `${head} is ${charged}; at these rates it should be ${expected}.`, totalOff: (charged: string, expected: string) => `The total ${charged} doesn't add up: taxable value plus tax is ${expected}.`, lutHint: "Exporting under an LUT? Then no IGST is right.", posDiffers: (state: string) => `Place of supply differs from the buyer's GSTIN state (${state}). Fine for bill-to / ship-to, otherwise check it.`, fix: (label: string) => `Use ${label}`, } export interface GstInvoiceCheckProps extends Omit, "onChange">, GstInvoice { /** Offers a one-tap fix that applies the expected tax heads and total. */ onFix?: (charged: GstCharged) => void /** Reword or translate any sentence. */ messages?: Partial } const fixClass = "inline-flex h-6 items-center rounded-md border border-amber-500/40 px-2 font-medium text-amber-900 transition-colors hover:bg-amber-500/10 dark:text-amber-200 outline-none focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50" /** * An invoice tax check for India. It reads the supplier's state from the GSTIN, compares it * with the place of supply and says whether the invoice needs CGST + SGST (or UTGST) or IGST, * then checks each rate against the slabs in force on the invoice date, the CGST/SGST split, * every tax amount and the total, with a one-tap fix to the right heads. */ export function GstInvoiceCheck({ supplierGstin, recipientGstin, placeOfSupply, supplyType, lines, charged, invoiceDate, roundOff, lut, onFix, messages, className, ...props }: GstInvoiceCheckProps) { const m = { ...GST_INVOICE_CHECK_MESSAGES, ...messages } const result = checkGstInvoice({ supplierGstin, recipientGstin, placeOfSupply, supplyType, lines, charged, invoiceDate, roundOff, lut }) const { from, pos, intra, type, localHead, expected, issues } = result const money = (n: number) => new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "currency", currency: "INR", maximumFractionDigits: 2 }).format(n) const state = (code?: string) => (code && GST_STATES[code] ? `${GST_STATES[code]} (${code})` : code ?? "—") const pct = (n: number) => `${n}%` const describe = (issue: GstIssue): [string, "error" | "warn" | "info"] => { switch (issue.kind) { case "gstin": return [m.gstin(issue.party), "error"] case "no-pos": return [m.noPos, "warn"] case "head": return [type === "sez" ? m.headSez : issue.wanted === "inter" ? m.headInter(state(from), state(pos)) : m.headIntra(state(from)), "error"] case "ut-head": return [m.utHead(HEADS[issue.wanted]), "warn"] case "split": return [m.split(money(issue.cgst), money(issue.other)), "error"] case "rate": return [m.rate(lines[issue.line]?.description ?? `Line ${issue.line + 1}`, pct(issue.rate), issue.retired, issue.endedOn, issue.rare), "warn"] case "lut": return [m.lut, "error"] case "amount": { const text = m.amount(HEADS[issue.head], money(issue.charged), money(issue.expected)) return [issue.head === "igst" && issue.charged === 0 && (type === "export" || type === "sez") ? `${text} ${m.lutHint}` : text, "error"] } case "total": return [m.totalOff(money(issue.charged), money(issue.expected)), "error"] case "pos-differs": return [m.posDiffers(state(issue.recipientState)), "info"] } } const fixable = issues.some((i) => i.kind === "head" || i.kind === "amount" || i.kind === "split" || i.kind === "ut-head" || i.kind === "total" || i.kind === "lut") const fixLabel = expected.igst === 0 && !intra ? `IGST ${money(0)}` : intra ? `CGST + ${HEADS[localHead]} ${money((expected.cgst ?? 0) * 2)}` : `IGST ${money(expected.igst ?? 0)}` const heads = (["cgst", "sgst", "utgst", "igst"] as const).filter((h) => charged[h] || expected[h]) const badge = type === "sez" ? m.sez : type === "export" ? m.export : intra ? m.intra(HEADS[localHead]) : m.inter const tone = { error: "text-destructive", warn: "text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400", info: "text-muted-foreground" } const Icon = { error: CircleAlert, warn: TriangleAlert, info: Info } const off = (a = 0, b = 0) => Math.abs(a - b) > 0.5 return (

meta.stops: Helps catch a GST invoice under the wrong tax head
meta.summary: Checks an Indian GST invoice for the wrong tax head (CGST + SGST vs IGST), a rate not in force on the invoice date, and amounts that don't add up.
catches: Intra-state vs inter-state head chosen wrongly from GSTIN state and place of supply
UTGST vs SGST for union territories without a legislature
Rate not in the slab set for the invoice date (pre-22 Sep 2025, GST 2.0, from 1 Feb 2026)
CGST/SGST not split evenly, or line amounts and total that don't add up
limits: Checks that a rate exists in a slab set, not that it is the right rate for the HSN/SAC
Does not validate the GSTIN on the GST portal
Ignores cess, reverse charge and composition cases
Rule tables are baked in; future rate changes need a code update
a11y: Section labelled by its title; tax table uses column headers
Findings list is a polite live region with icons that are decorative

sources.label: Notification 19/2025-Central Tax (Rate), 31 Dec 2025 (28%/14% schedule omitted, tobacco to 40%, biris to 18% from 1 Feb 2026)

rules.note: Informational; check the official source. Verified: the 1 Feb 2026 change. The 22 Sep 2025 GST 2.0 slab set (Notification 9/2025-CT(R)) and the UTGST state-code list were not re-fetched this round.
